title: どこかで春が (Dokoka de Haru ga — Somewhere Spring Is Born)
description: A tender 1923 spring song describing the invisible sounds and signs of spring arriving: melting water, a skylark's call, the crackling of new buds. Three short verses with vivid sensory imagery, each building to the closing line 'どこかで春が生まれてる'. Written by poet 百田宗治 and composer 草川信, who also wrote 夕焼け小焼け. A favourite in Japanese elementary school music classes.
